title: FarmTact V19 — Council decision cards
summary: Calculated plans now pair a compact, evidence-bound decision brief with an optional Planning Council review, while retaining the complete one-farm card experience.

changes.title: Bring Council into the planning decision
changes.description: Each calculated strategy exposes Explain, an explicit optional Council review, and More. Council is bound to that plan's frozen result and revision; it advises but cannot save, approve or operate a farm.

changes.title: Restore layered decision context in cards
changes.description: Plan cards show dated allocation samples, affected beds, review status and clear authority boundaries. The five tool decks retain crop profiles, evidence, research, Data Explorer and replay without returning to a maze of screens.

changes.title: Keep browsing and consequences trustworthy
changes.description: Previews, swipes, explanations and replay make no provider request. Explicit reviews use the existing validated gateway; planning, approval and recorded simulation remain separate, revision-bound workflows with actual operations disabled.
